name: Blood in the Urine (Hematuria)
shortDescription: Blood in the urine—known as hematuria—can be alarming and should never be ignored. RoMIUS Urology provides urgent evaluation and thorough diagnostic workups for both men and women to identify the cause quickly and ensure timely, effective treatment. Whether the blood is visible (gross hematuria) or detected only on a urine test (microscopic hematuria), our team follows evidence-based guidelines to determine the source and protect long-term urinary health.
body:
Why Blood in the Urine Matters

Hematuria can have many possible causes, ranging from benign to serious. Some causes require immediate treatment to prevent complications. Common sources include:

  • Kidney stones
  • Urinary tract infections
  • Enlarged prostate (in men)
  • Bladder or kidney irritation
  • Recent exercise or dehydration
  • Bladder or kidney cancer
  • Trauma
  • Medications or blood thinners

Because some of these conditions are serious, prompt evaluation is essential.

Timely Evaluation & Advanced Diagnostics

RoMIUS Urology offers rapid access across Northwest and West Central Ohio, ensuring patients are evaluated quickly and comfortably. Our diagnostic approach may include:

  • Urinalysis
  • Urine culture
  • Urine cytology (cancer screening)
  • Imaging (ultrasound, CT scan)
  • Cystoscopy – a brief office procedure to inspect the bladder

These tools allow us to identify the cause of bleeding accurately and efficiently.

Expert Care for All Causes of Hematuria

Our team is experienced in managing all underlying conditions that may lead to blood in the urine, including:

  • Kidney stones (with rapid triage and surgical access)
  • Bladder and kidney tumors
  • Infections and inflammation
  • Prostate enlargement or prostatitis
  • Trauma or catheter-related bleeding
  • Abnormal kidney function or glomerular causes

We ensure each patient receives the appropriate care pathway and timely follow-up.

Men and Women: Tailored Evaluation for Each Patient

Although hematuria affects both men and women, the causes can differ:

Men

  • Prostate enlargement
  • Prostatitis
  • Urethral strictures
  • Bladder tumors
  • Kidney stones

Women

  • UTIs
  • Bladder irritation
  • Kidney stones
  • Pelvic anatomy factors
  • Rare urothelial tumors

RoMIUS Urology tailors diagnostic strategies based on each patient’s anatomy, medical history, and risk factors.

A Patient-Centered Approach

We understand that seeing blood in the urine is stressful. Our team focuses on:

  • Fast access to appointments
  • Clear explanations of every step
  • Minimizing discomfort during testing
  • Coordinating imaging and labs quickly
  • Ensuring patient safety and peace of mind

Patients are never left waiting for answers.

Long-Term Monitoring & Prevention

Depending on the cause, RoMIUS Urology provides long-term surveillance when needed, including:

  • Repeat urinalysis
  • Imaging follow-up
  • Cystoscopy surveillance for at-risk patients
  • Ongoing evaluation for recurrent hematuria

Our goal is to ensure that any future recurrence is caught early and managed effectively.

Why Patients Trust RoMIUS Urology for Hematuria

  • Rapid appointments and urgent access
  • Evidence-based diagnostic pathways
  • Expertise in kidney stones, infections, tumors, and prostate issues
  • Comfortable in-office cystoscopy
  • Seamless coordination of imaging and labs
  • Personalized, compassionate care for both men and women
